sources.source: There are no complete sets to sort.
Two channels cannot both give the {roles} mask.
The mask of {image} is {mask_shape}; the image is {shape}.
The images of set {name} differ in size: {sizes}
{count} set(s) have no {role} mask in channel {channel}. Those sets cannot be merged when merging is requested.
No channel has masks. When merging is requested, stack/ is written but merged/ is not.

Move {images} image(s) and {masks} mask(s) into {channels} channel folder(s) under {dest}, as {sets} set(s) in Yokogawa naming. Then build channel stacks and any merged arrays supported by the available masks.
